description: How human clients phrase contracts: businesslike, a little bureaucratic, mindful of paperwork and liability.

h-hail: You're the captain with the free hold? Good.
Morning, Captain. Or evening. I've lost track.
Captain {captain}, I'll get to the point.
h-intro: I act for {faction}, and I'm authorised to agree terms.
I'm {client}. {faction} has a job that needs an outside hand.
My name's {client}. I'm told you don't ask more questions than you need to.
{faction} would rather not use its own people for this.
I handle contracts for {faction}, and this one is on my desk.
h-frame: I'll give you the short version.
This is a plain job, and I'd like it to stay plain.
The details are in the file, but here's what matters.
There's a form for this, but I'll just tell you.
I need something done and I need someone reliable.
I'd call it routine, though nothing is routine lately.
We have a problem, and you can fix it.
h-clock: The window is {deadline}, and it won't be extended.
I can give you {deadline}, no more.
It has to be done within {deadline}.
The clock started before I called you.
h-clock2: I'd rather not explain a delay upstairs.
Don't leave it to the last day.
Late is as good as failed, on paper.
Allow for the usual port delays.
h-stakes: A delay costs me more than it costs you.
If it slips, it goes to my superiors, and then to yours.
A lot rests on the timing.
I'd like this closed before the quarter ends.
Someone has to sign off on it, and they leave soon.
The longer it takes, the worse it looks.
h-offer: {reward}, paid when it's done. Standard terms.
h-terms: It clears within the hour of completion.
There's no haggling room, but there is no catch either.
h-bonus: Do it cleanly and I'll mention you for the next contract.
I may be able to find a little extra for a tidy result.
Do well and there's repeat work.
I keep a list of captains I trust.
h-caution: Stay off the main lanes if you can.
Watch who you talk to in port.
Not everyone will want this finished.
h-caution2: I'd rather not hear about it from the news.
If something looks wrong, it probably is.
Report in if the plan changes.
h-conseq: Don't expect {faction} to vouch for you if it goes wrong.
I can't help you if the port authority gets involved.
I'll have to disown the whole thing, officially.
If it goes badly, we never met.
Breach of terms voids the fee.
I'm not liable for what happens out there.
h-part: Let's both get what we need from this.
Call if there's a problem. Preferably early.
Make it quick and make it quiet.
I look forward to closing the file.
Do right by me and I'll do right by you.
